svg.title: Fi, Li, Si and Gi — storage and backup relationships
svg.desc: Configured backup policy, checked against host receipts on 25 October 2026. Blue arrows indicate synchronization, green arrows backup, purple parity, amber pending verification or coverage gaps.
svg.text: What lives where. What brings it back.
FI · desktop LI · laptop SI · server giD · Google Drive
Local work → shared cloud copy + separate backup
Fi sync :05 · Li sync :35 each hour.
Li runs only if Fi has not succeeded today.
Application state and library → two encrypted repositories
Online SQLite snapshots + native DB dump
Bulk media and Docker images excluded
App updates require success <24 h old.
Run at 04:00 HKT + up to 5 min jitter
Fi pulls retained snapshots from Si.
Full repository data check after copying.
Offsite only when Fi is physically elsewhere
R2 archives are separate from Google Drive
SSH / GPG · selected app state · keys
Does not archive each entire home directory
Per folder: latest only, or up to 3 tiers:
Parity, synchronization and recoverable history serve different roles
Daily 05:00 sync · Sunday 08:00 scrub of 25% of eligible blocks.
Disk-failure / corruption protection; no independent versioned copy.
App state, downloads and recovery staging are outside parity coverage.
Google Docs / Sheets / Slides are excluded from local folder sync.
Encrypted mail archives live under private/archives/mail/structured.
No independent scheduled backup route is defined for this scope.
Basis: managed configuration + live timer / receipt checks. This is a policy map, not a restore-test certificate.
Private client backups are not included in the Si application-repository copy to Fi. Times are HKT; timers can catch up after missed runs.
